headline: Crude Oil Futures Fall as Traders Monitor Diplomatic Signals on Iran
summary: Oil prices declined as traders parsed signs of fresh diplomacy regarding Iran, with negotiations taking place through mediators.
why: Global oil benchmarks remain highly responsive to Middle East geopolitical risks due to potential supply disruptions.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Emerging diplomatic efforts reduced the immediate geopolitical risk premium priced into crude oil.

why_moved: Reports of active diplomatic mediation involving Iran moderated supply fear premiums in crude markets.
